policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV begins directly with 'After this', supporting base Μετὰ rather than Καὶ μετὰ.
Under negation, ASV 'any tree' can represent either πᾶν or indefinite τι.
ASV 'till' is equally compatible with ἄχρι and expanded ἄχρι οὗ.
ASV's 'and' in 'a hundred and forty' is normal English numeral composition and does not securely distinguish an added Greek καί.
ASV 'them that were sealed' does not preserve the nominative-versus-genitive participial form.
ASV 'sealed' does not preserve the masculine-versus-feminine participial form.
ASV 'sealed' does not preserve the masculine-versus-feminine participial form.
ASV's non-resumptive relative 'which no man could number' is compatible with Greek containing or omitting resumptive αὐτόν.
ASV 'standing' does not preserve the nominative-versus-accusative participial form.
ASV 'palms' does not preserve the nominative-versus-accusative form.
ASV's explicit note 'Greek have said' identifies perfect εἴρηκα rather than aorist εἶπον.
ASV 'made them white' directly represents αὐτάς, omitted by RP.
ASV 'before the throne' does not distinguish genitive τοῦ θρόνου from dative τῷ θρόνῳ after ἐνώπιον.
ASV 'nor' does not expose whether the Greek has simple οὐδέ or reinforced οὐδ᾽ οὐ.
ASV future 'shall be their shepherd' supports future ποιμανεῖ rather than present ποιμαίνει.
ASV future 'shall guide' supports future ὁδηγήσει rather than present ὁδηγεῖ.
